configuration.changes: Independent 32-tile PE kernel. Weights transformed before each call in testbench; input/output transforms use fabric adds/subtracts. Direct integer2x2 outputs are checked exhaustively for each deterministic random tile, including extrema.
configuration.conclusion: Use only numerically exact and measured primitives in full-network integration.
